title: SendUSDC
tagline: Spell Caster is able to cast up to 5 users with USDC in 1 single transaction.
description:
Using the power of transferwithAuth in USDC.
Spell Caster is able to cast up to 5 users with USDC in 1 single transaction.
To save time and save cost of sending to multiple receivers.
Spell Caster users off chain signature function implemented in USDC to achieve batching of transaction with 1 signature and 1 transaction.
how_its_made:
This project use offchain signature EIP 3009 to approve contract tokens to batch up to 5 USDC transactions.



User interact with a deployed contract , sending in signatures and addresses , amounts to batch transactions.

We intend to add in ENS transfer but we don't have enough time. However , we manage to change display user's own ENS in their display panel.
